protocol_alignment.hidden_width_note: Aligned with AD-HG-DAPPO main trainer default and trained checkpoints (d_h=32).
protocol_alignment.matched_simulation_budget: In --budget-mode matched_sim (default), ETDQN episodes scale by 1/(1 + ga_population * ga_generations) for approximately matched event simulation budget. Actual counts can differ due to failed teacher trials and must be reported from train.csv.

paper_boundary_statement: 为统一动作空间与物理约束，本文参考 AM-A2C、Transformer-A3C、ETDQN 及注意力增强 DDQN 的表征与更新机制，在相同的 PCB 分批—放置双阶段决策框架、合法动作掩码和标量奖励下构建适配基线（分别记作 AM-A2C-PCB、TRANSFORMER-A3C-PCB、ETDQN-PCB 和 ATTENTION-DDQN-PCB）。

am_a2c.changed: PCB typed entity attention and two sequential decisions; mutation uses explicit mixture likelihood; original cloud objective removed
am_a2c.missing: full original implementation and formula-by-formula mutation audit

transformer_a3c.retained: causal history Transformer, asynchronous local gradients
transformer_a3c.changed: PCB categorical split and placement; episode n-step rollout; central Adam gradient delivery
transformer_a3c.missing: full original temporal feature/rollout hyperparameter equivalence

etdqn.retained: evolutionary simulator teacher and fixed Q regression targets without target network bootstrapping
etdqn.changed: direct candidate action tape GA; current-event return teacher replaces original genetic encoding and evaluation; attention encoder
etdqn.missing: paper-equivalent genetic representation, state evaluator and rule-selector reproduction

iddqn.publication_name_note: The paper does not name its method IDDQN-II; internal key 'iddqn' is retained only for checkpoint compatibility.
iddqn.retained: attention, decoupled decision components, Double Q selection/evaluation
iddqn.changed: single common PCB objective replaces multiobjective adaptive weighting; direct template and slot scoring replaces original rules
iddqn.missing: original multiobjective adaptive weights and exact action-decoupling architecture

claim_allowed: Comparing four explicitly described PCB method adaptations (AM-A2C-PCB, TRANSFORMER-A3C-PCB, ETDQN-PCB, ATTENTION-DDQN-PCB) under a common environment and approximately matched, explicitly audited simulation budgets
claim_forbidden: Exact original paper reproduction; proven dual-Actor superiority; equivalent training compute without budget audit
formal_release_requirements: record equal tuning trials on validation only
freeze training schedule and environment-call/compute budgets including GA trials
run all five seeds on matched panels
report all failures and paired confidence intervals
